title: Citadel Hub
summary: A way for me to manage my digital estate, with API integration for external services. Hosted locally, and served via a dashboard.
body:
::figure[screenshot-20260927-084846]

## Why I built it
I was sick of going to my council website every week to see which bins I needed to put out, surely I could automate that? It escalated from there. 

The GitHub repo is currently private, while my secrets and API keys are .gitignored, I'm sill nervous about making this public without a thorough vetting. 

## How it works
Hosted locally on a linux server, and open to any device on my network. It includes IP whitelisting and MAC address filtering so settings and sensitive information are only available from dedicated devices. Guest devices only have access to the media server.

Each tile can be expanded to show a detailed view. Upcoming vinyl pre-orders show price comparisons, local services show activity logs, etc. 

The music radar is tailored to me, showing information only about artists that have either 100 plays on Spotify, are already part of my physical collection, or are explicitly defined. 

## What it contains
Dashboard:
- Google calendar integration (Google API)
- Upcoming music releases (MusicBrainz API)
- Upcoming vinyl preorders (Web scraping)
- Gig radar of upcoming concerts (Ticketmaster API)
- System monitoring for temperatures and disk space
- A launchpad for local applications 
- Services monitoring and logging

Media server:
- Hosted on a dedicated JellyFin install
- Digitised TV and Film library
- Extensive live concert archive

Music Companion:
- Fully integrated Music Companion
- See the project page for full details

Settings:
- Device enrolment and activity logs
- Backups update schedule
- Easy adding of new stores, news feeds, and local applications.
